Demonstrated experience and thorough working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and database applications

Incumbent is responsible for tracking and analysis of work-related injuries and illnesses at UCI across the entire enterprise. Identifies patterns and trends; researches and analyzes relevant data, recommends corrective actions and monitors the results of corrective actions. Manages data analysis projects, creates and maintains department dashboard and provides general administrative support as needed. Evaluates current system and process and implement changes as needed with the leadership approval. Is responsible for creating and submitting regulatory compliance reports including those submitted to NHSN annually regarding healthcare worker vaccination rates. Identifies current gaps in data collection and analysis and devise methods to eliminate these discrepancies. Provides cost benefit analysis for new workflows and/or new services provided by the Occupational Health clinics.
Familiar with and able to comfortably utilize and schedule in Outlook, Teams, and Zoom
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Knowledge of the EPinet Program (Exposure Prevention Information Network)
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Knowledge of University and medical center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality; knowledge of HIPAA and PHI requirements
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Excellent PC skills to design and maintain custom databases, produce reports, and capture and manipulate data
Ability to work independently and take initiative to identify priorities and manage workload accordingly
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to comprehend & utilize computer systems to retrieve & enter data.
